findings.text: baseline_suite and after_suite are prose, while the manifest's own contract (prompt.txt:121-122) requires JSON carrying log_path and failure_ids, so the store's annotate_review_of_run (reckon/crew/review.py:848) reports the run's added-failure count unmeasured at read time, and this review reconstructed it from the head gate log plus its own base arm instead.

the gate logs carry no header naming the revision, tree or command that produced them, as the manifest's own contract (prompt.txt:116) requires, so a later reader cannot bind the recorded results to the revision they measured without trusting the manifest's word.
